default.label: Mira Recommended
default.description: Tested local Mira setup. Advanced mode is available for unvalidated model experiments.

llama3.2:3b.label: Llama 3.2 3B
llama3.2:3b.warning: Smaller general-purpose model; best when you want speed and lower thermals.

phi4-mini.label: Phi-4 Mini
phi4-mini.warning: Strong small-model reasoning; good Copilot default on lower-memory machines.

qwen2.5:3b.label: Qwen 2.5 3B
qwen2.5:3b.warning: Very fast small multilingual option; best when speed matters more than maximum categorization accuracy.

qwen3:4b.label: Qwen 3 4B
qwen3:4b.warning: Can leak reasoning text instead of a clean category label, so avoid it for strict local categorization.

gemma4:e2b.label: Gemma 4 E2B
gemma4:e2b.warning: Viable on 8 GB laptops, but near the upper edge of comfortable local memory use.

gemma4:e4b.label: Gemma 4 E4B
gemma4:e4b.warning: Tested Mira default for chat, controller, and categorization. Ollama may use more memory at runtime than the download size.

hf.co/HauhauCS/Gemma-4-E4B-Uncensored-Ha.label: Gemma 4 E4B Uncensored Q5
hf.co/HauhauCS/Gemma-4-E4B-Uncensored-Ha.warning: Experimental Hugging Face GGUF pulled through Ollama. Use for Mira Copilot testing only; avoid for categorization and unattended write-heavy workflows.

gemma3:4b.label: Gemma 3 4B
gemma3:4b.warning: Reliable smaller Gemma-family option when you want cooler sustained runs.

qwen2.5:7b.label: Qwen 2.5 7B
qwen2.5:7b.warning: Excellent balanced choice for 16 GB and 32 GB laptops; one of the best speed-to-quality categorization options tested locally.

qwen3:8b.label: Qwen 3 8B
qwen3:8b.warning: Better suited to richer Copilot interactions than strict categorization imports; Qwen 3 models may need extra no-thinking controls to format reliably.

deepseek-r1:8b.label: DeepSeek-R1 8B
deepseek-r1:8b.warning: Reasoning-heavy model; not recommended for bulk categorization on laptops.

gemma4:26b.label: Gemma 4 26B
gemma4:26b.warning: High-memory Advisor model. Setup uses it only when system RAM is at least 30 GB; chat stays on Gemma 4 E4B by default.

gemma4:31b.label: Gemma 4 31B
gemma4:31b.warning: Fits on some 32 GB machines, but it is intentionally expert-only and not chosen automatically.

gemma3:12b.label: Gemma 3 12B
gemma3:12b.warning: Strong 32 GB quality-first categorization option when you want better accuracy and can accept slower throughput than Gemma 4 E4B.

qwen2.5:14b.label: Qwen 2.5 14B
qwen2.5:14b.warning: Strong 32 GB Copilot option with good quality-to-size tradeoff.

qwen3:14b.label: Qwen 3 14B
qwen3:14b.warning: Better for richer assistant tasks than repetitive batch labeling.

mistral-small:24b.label: Mistral Small 24B
mistral-small:24b.warning: High-quality local assistant option, but intentionally de-emphasized for routine laptop use.
